name: curatormd-v2-status
description: A local, project-scoped CuratorMD V2 dashboard and status bar integration.

curatormdV2.serverCommand.description: Absolute path or PATH command for the locally installed Curator V2 MCP launcher.

curatormdV2.hermesCommand.description: Absolute path or PATH command for Hermes with the machine-readable Curator host-readiness probe.

curatormdV2.hermesProfileBindings.description: Owner-managed map from exact Curator project IDs to Hermes profile IDs used for readiness checks.

curatormdV2.databaseBindings.description: Owner-managed map from exact Curator project IDs to absolute local SQLite database paths. Exact project entries override databasePath.

curatormdV2.evidenceConfigBindings.description: Owner-managed map from exact Curator project IDs to absolute host evidence files. An exact empty-string entry disables the fallback evidenceConfig for that project.

curatormdV2.reviewCommand.description: Optional attended review CLI path or PATH command; defaults to the executable beside serverCommand, or curatormd-v2-review on PATH.

curatormdV2.evidenceConfig.description: Optional absolute path to the owner-only host evidence JSON config; never set this in workspace settings.

curatormdV2.databasePath.description: Absolute path to the local Curator V2 database.

curatormdV2.profileId.description: Host-configured profile routing label; authorization comes from the local OS UID and exact project grant.
